items.text: Spare Keys pilot board: tenants mistake the new caretaker for an inspector. Reveal his identity at the very end, after the boiler-room farce.
Dialogue notebook: Bea speaks in precise corrections; Otis answers questions with stories that wander. Avoid giving them the same sarcastic rhythm.
Starter barely rose overnight. Mark the level after feeding and keep the jar away from the cold kitchen window.
Screenplay workshop registration: Saturday afternoon session costs 45. Check the cancellation policy before booking the place.
Spare Keys pitch packet needs logline, half-page series premise and three episode ideas. Keep pilot scene breakdown out of the main two pages.
Pilot board correction: reveal the caretaker midway through, not at the end. The second half works better if everyone knows and pretends they don't.
Bea dialogue exercise: replace three vague complaints with exact counts. Otis's answer about a missing key should drift into his first summer job.
Workshop receipt 45 paid, Saturday place confirmed. Venue moved upstairs; ask whether the lift is working before arriving.
Two-page pitch draft: every resident holds a spare key to someone else's flat, making privacy impossible. Find an episode idea that tests trust without another lost-key plot.
Warm shelf / second half / leave it longer
items.rationale: Unresolved blend of food and writing cues.

items.text: Starter doubled in six hours on the warm shelf. Keep the same feeding ratio tomorrow before trying a loaf.

Pilot hallway scene now exposes the caretaker halfway through. Rewrite Bea's reaction as a numbered correction and Otis's as a rambling anecdote; save those lines in the voice notebook as anchors for later episodes.
items.rationale: Revises an ordered pilot scene and shared character-voice anchors.

items.text: Workshop organiser confirms lift access and emailed directions. Bring a printed scene and the booking receipt; no laptop needed.
Spare Keys pitch page feels dense. Cut the invented building history; use that space for the comic engine and why these neighbours stay together.
Read Bea and Otis without names above the lines. Bea is recognizable, Otis still sounds too concise; let him dodge one question before answering.
Pilot continuity pass: caretaker leaves the master keys on the stairs in scene four, so he cannot unlock the boiler room in scene five. Add a retrieval beat.
Starter jar has dried batter around the rim. Transfer a spoonful to a clean jar at the next feed and mark the new level.
Workshop booking closed out: attended Saturday, receipt filed with learning expenses. The organiser sent next month's dates but I have not booked again.
Maybe make him warmer. Ask on Saturday.
items.rationale: No character identity or concrete task evidence.

items.text: Spare Keys pitch packet exported to two pages: premise, ensemble and three distinct episode hooks. Test the PDF fonts before sending to the producer.
